default.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion container background. Use for the accordion root surface across all size variants. Accessibility: maintain strong contrast with trigger text and panel text in both default and interactive states.

color.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion root border color. Use for the outer boundary of grouped accordion items. Accessibility: pair with clear focus styling and avoid relying on border color alone for state communication.

open.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion root open and focus border color. Use when an expanded item or focused trigger should highlight the outer wrapper. Accessibility: keep this color aligned with the trigger focus treatment so state change and focus remain visually coherent.

width.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion root border width. Use as the default outline thickness around the accordion container. Accessibility: preserve visible boundaries at zoom and in high-contrast modes.

radius.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion root corner radius. Use for the component-level container radius so all item separators remain visually aligned. Accessibility: ensure focus outlines are not clipped by rounded corners.

color.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger focus ring color. Use for keyboard focus-visible outlines on trigger controls. Accessibility: keep focus indicators clearly visible and avoid color-only state cues by pairing with ring width.

width.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger focus ring width. Use as the default focus outline thickness for trigger controls. Accessibility: 2px or greater helps preserve visibility under zoom and custom contrast settings.

offset.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger focus ring offset. Use to separate trigger focus outlines from surrounding borders and neighboring items. Accessibility: maintain visible spacing between focus indicators and control edges.

opacity.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for disabled accordion opacity. Use for disabled root, item, or trigger presentation while retaining disabled semantics in markup. Accessibility: never use reduced opacity as the only disabled indicator.

default.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger default background. Use for collapsed and resting trigger rows. Accessibility: ensure text contrast against this surface remains WCAG compliant.

hover.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger hover background. Use for pointer hover feedback on enabled triggers. Accessibility: do not rely on hover styling alone; focus-visible states must be independently clear.

active.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger active background. Use while pressing trigger controls. Accessibility: active styles should remain distinguishable from hover and open states.

open.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger open-state background. Use when a trigger controls an expanded panel. Accessibility: reinforce open state with ARIA attributes and panel visibility changes, not color alone.

default.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger default text and icon color. Use for label content in collapsed and neutral trigger states. Accessibility: maintain sufficient contrast on all trigger backgrounds.

open.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger open-state text and icon color. Use for the expanded trigger state to increase information scent. Accessibility: ensure open-state contrast remains compliant with associated background colors.

size.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger text size. Use for trigger labels across density variants unless responsive overrides are required. Accessibility: keep trigger labels readable at common zoom levels and minimum viewport widths.

weight.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger text weight. Use for trigger labels to preserve hierarchy over panel body content. Accessibility: maintain legibility and avoid relying on weight changes alone to indicate state.

lineHeight.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger line height. Use to align trigger typography with body and panel text rhythm. Accessibility: preserve readable line spacing for multi-line trigger labels.

gap.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion trigger content gap. Use spacing between trigger label text and optional indicator icons. Accessibility: keep icon/text relationships clear without shrinking touch targets.

default.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion panel background. Use for expanded content regions under each trigger. Accessibility: ensure panel text contrast remains compliant with this background token.

Accretion UI semantic token for accordion panel text color. Use for panel body copy, links, and supporting metadata. Accessibility: verify at least 4.5:1 contrast for default body text where feasible.

color.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion panel separator color. Use for top borders that separate trigger and panel content. Accessibility: keep separators supplemental to structure and do not use them as the sole grouping cue.

minHeight.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for compact accordion trigger minimum height. Use for dense interfaces where vertical space is constrained. Accessibility: verify touch target size remains usable or provide additional hit-area padding.

paddingBlock.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for compact accordion trigger block padding. Use to reduce vertical spacing in compact density mode. Accessibility: keep trigger hit areas easy to activate with pointer and keyboard users.

paddingInline.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for compact accordion trigger inline padding. Use to preserve readable spacing around text in compact layouts. Accessibility: maintain enough whitespace for legible scanning at zoom.

gap.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for compact accordion trigger gap. Use for icon/text spacing in compact mode. Accessibility: keep icon and label separation clear without creating ambiguous click targets.

paddingInline.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for compact accordion panel inline padding. Use for dense panel content layouts. Accessibility: preserve sufficient reading margin for wrapped text content.

paddingBlockStart.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for compact accordion panel start padding. Use to keep equal top and bottom breathing room by default in compact mode. Accessibility: preserve enough vertical whitespace for comfortable reading.

paddingBlockEnd.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for compact accordion panel end padding. Use to maintain comfortable spacing after panel content in compact mode. Accessibility: avoid crowded endings that reduce readability.

minHeight.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for comfortable accordion trigger minimum height. Use as the default density for mixed desktop and touch usage. Accessibility: aligns with recommended target sizes for primary interactive controls.

paddingBlock.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for comfortable accordion trigger block padding. Use for default trigger vertical spacing. Accessibility: preserve readable line wrapping and pointer target stability.

paddingInline.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for comfortable accordion trigger inline padding. Use for default horizontal trigger spacing. Accessibility: keep labels away from borders for easier scanning.

gap.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for comfortable accordion trigger gap. Use as the default spacing between labels and indicator icons. Accessibility: supports clear icon-to-label association without crowding.

paddingInline.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for comfortable accordion panel inline padding. Use for default panel text margins. Accessibility: helps preserve readability for longer body copy.

paddingBlockStart.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for comfortable accordion panel start padding. Use as the default top spacing for expanded panels so block padding remains even by default. Accessibility: keep enough vertical whitespace for legible text blocks.

paddingBlockEnd.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for comfortable accordion panel end padding. Use as default bottom spacing for expanded panels. Accessibility: keep breathing room below panel content for visual clarity.

minHeight.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for spacious accordion trigger minimum height. Use for touch-first and content-led layouts that need larger controls. Accessibility: larger targets can improve activation success for motor and low-vision users.

paddingBlock.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for spacious accordion trigger block padding. Use to increase vertical rhythm in spacious mode. Accessibility: provides extra breathing room for multiline labels and enlarged text.

paddingInline.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for spacious accordion trigger inline padding. Use for larger-screen layouts where extra horizontal space improves scanning. Accessibility: supports readability with increased zoom and touch usage.

gap.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for spacious accordion trigger gap. Use for icon/text separation in spacious mode. Accessibility: preserves clear structure and prevents visual crowding.

paddingInline.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for spacious accordion panel inline padding. Use for wider text margins in generous layouts. Accessibility: improved line-length control can aid readability for longer content.

paddingBlockStart.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for spacious accordion panel start padding. Use to preserve even vertical breathing room in spacious mode. Accessibility: additional whitespace can reduce visual fatigue in dense information panels.

paddingBlockEnd.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for spacious accordion panel end padding. Use for larger content rhythm in spacious mode. Accessibility: additional whitespace can reduce visual fatigue in dense information panels.

duration.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion expand/collapse duration. Use for panel reveal and collapse transitions. Accessibility: respect reduced-motion preferences by shortening or removing transition duration.

easing.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for accordion expand/collapse easing. Use for consistent motion timing across trigger and panel transitions. Accessibility: preserve orientation while minimizing disorienting movement.
